content.title: Fall River area grocery stores open and closed on Easter. See the list
content.text: April 5, 2026, 6:02 a.m. ETNeed to grab some last-minute marshmallow Peeps or eggs to dye on Easter? What about that glazed ham? Many Massachusetts grocery stores in the Fall River area are open on Easter Sunday, but their hours may be limited.While no state laws prevent supermarkets from opening as usual on Easter, many opt to open with limited hours to allow employees to celebrate the holiday.To avoid any surprises, shoppers should check store hours before heading out to the supermarket on Sunday, April 5.Here's what to know about popular Massachusetts grocery stores on the spring holiday.Is Stop & Shop open on Easter 2026?Most Massachusetts Stop & Shop stores are open until 5 p.m. on Easter Sunday, the website said.Is Market Basket open on Easter 2026?All Market Basket stores, including the ones Fall River and New Bedford are closed on Easter Sunday.Is Shaw's/Star Market open on Easter 2026?Most Shaw's and Star Market locations are open regular business hours on Easter Sunday.Is Big Y open on Easter 2026?Big Y grocery stores are closed on Sunday, April 5, according to the chain's website.Is ALDI open on Easter 2026?ALDI locations will be closed on Easter Sunday, including the Fall River and Dartmouth stores, according to the chain's website.Is Price Rite open on Easter 2026?Price Rite stores in New Bedford and Fall River are open from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.Is Hannaford open on Easter 2026?Most Hannaford locations in Massachusetts are open until 3 p.m. on Sunday, April 5, according to the supermarket chain's website. This includes the Middleboro and Taunton stores.As store hours vary by location, customers are encouraged to check their local store's website.Is Wegmans open on Easter 2026?Wegmans – including the locations in Chestnut Hill, Medford, and Burlington – are open normal business hours on Easter Sunday, according to a company spokesperson.Certain departments may have modified or shortened hours, so customers should contact their local store for more information, Wegmans said.Is Whole Foods open on Easter 2026?Many Whole Foods locations are open on Easter Sunday, but with modified hours, the chain's website said.Boston's Ink Block and Charles River Plaza locations will be open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Sunday, April 5. The Shrewsbury, Hingham, Beverly, and Framingham locations will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.Customers should check their local store's website for details.Is Trader Joe's open on Easter 2026?All Trader Joe's stores are open regular hours on Easter 2026.Is Walmart open on Easter 2026?Walmart stores are open regular hours on Easter Sunday, according to the company. This includes the Swansea, Fall River and Dartmouth locations.Is Target open on Easter 2026?All Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to the company's website.Is Costco open on Easter 2026?All Costco warehouses in Massachusetts will be closed on Easter 2026, according to the company.This includes the Avon, Danvers, Dedham, Everett, Sharon, Waltham, and West Springfield locations.Is BJ's Wholesale Club open on Easter 2026?Most BJ's Wholesale Club locations are open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday, according to the company. However, customers should check with their local club to confirm hours.
